test_cases.summary:
Verify Data loads quickly
when the page is opened
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Page Management
Scenario: Data loads quickly
Given the page is opened
When data is fetched
Then labels should render within acceptable time without blocking UI
test_cases.acceptance:
Labels should render within acceptable time without blocking UI
The behavior should be validated when data is fetched.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Name cannot be empty
when the Create Session Label popup is open
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Name Validation – Mandatory Field
Scenario: Name cannot be empty
Given the Create Session Label popup is open
When the Name field is left empty and user clicks Create
Then submission should be blocked and inline validation message displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
Submission should be blocked and inline validation message displayed
The behavior should be validated when the Name field is left empty and user clicks Create.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Name contains only spaces
when the Name field contains only spaces
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Name Validation – Space-only Restriction
Scenario: Name contains only spaces
Given the Name field contains only spaces
When the user submits
Then system should trim input and display validation error
test_cases.acceptance:
System should trim input and display validation error
The behavior should be validated when the user submits.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Valid alphanumeric name accepted
when the user enters a valid label name
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Name Validation – Valid Input Acceptance
Scenario: Valid alphanumeric name accepted
Given the user enters a valid label name
When the user submits
Then the label should be created successfully
test_cases.acceptance:
The label should be created successfully
The behavior should be validated when the user submits.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Restricted characters entered
when the Name field contains invalid characters (!,@,#,$,%, etc.)
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Name Validation – Invalid Special Characters
Scenario: Restricted characters entered
Given the Name field contains invalid characters (!,@,#,$,%, etc.)
When validation runs
Then invalid characters should be rejected and error displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
Invalid characters should be rejected and error displayed
The behavior should be validated when validation runs.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Exceed max character limit
when the Name exceeds the maximum allowed length
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Name Validation – Maximum Length
Scenario: Exceed max character limit
Given the Name exceeds the maximum allowed length
When user types beyond the limit
Then input should be blocked or truncated
test_cases.acceptance:
Input should be blocked or truncated
The behavior should be validated when user types beyond the limit.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Error message placement
when validation fails
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Name Validation – Inline Error Visibility
Scenario: Error message placement
Given validation fails
When error appears
Then inline message should display below field with red highlight
test_cases.acceptance:
Inline message should display below field with red highlight
The behavior should be validated when error appears.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Validate on blur
when user leaves Name field (blur)
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Name Validation – Blur Validation
Scenario: Validate on blur
Given user leaves Name field (blur)
When invalid input exists
Then validation message should trigger immediately
test_cases.acceptance:
Validation message should trigger immediately
The behavior should be validated when invalid input exists.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Validate again on submit
when valid input earlier
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Name Validation – Submit Validation
Scenario: Validate again on submit
Given valid input earlier
When submitting
Then system should revalidate before API call
test_cases.acceptance:
System should revalidate before API call
The behavior should be validated when submitting.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Validation fails
when invalid name
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Name Validation – Prevent API Call on Failure
Scenario: Validation fails
Given invalid name
When submit pressed
Then no API request should be triggered
test_cases.acceptance:
No API request should be triggered
The behavior should be validated when submit pressed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Non-technical error messages
when validation fails
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Name Validation – User-friendly Messaging
Scenario: Non-technical error messages
Given validation fails
When message shown
Then message should be simple and understandable
test_cases.acceptance:
Message should be simple and understandable
The behavior should be validated when message shown.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Description field is visible
when the Create/Edit Session Label popup is opened
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Description Validation – Description field available for optional details
Scenario: Description field is visible
Given the Create/Edit Session Label popup is opened
When the form loads
Then the Description input field should be visible and editable
test_cases.acceptance:
The Description input field should be visible and editable
The behavior should be validated when the form loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify User enters alphanumeric text
when the Description field is focused
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Description Validation – Accept valid characters
Scenario: User enters alphanumeric text
Given the Description field is focused
When the user types valid characters
Then the input should be accepted without validation errors
test_cases.acceptance:
The input should be accepted without validation errors
The behavior should be validated when the user types valid characters.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Enter description within limit
when the maximum limit is defined
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Description Validation – Maximum character limit enforcement
Scenario: Enter description within limit
Given the maximum limit is defined
When the user enters text less than or equal to the limit
Then the system should allow saving successfully
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should allow saving successfully
The behavior should be validated when the user enters text less than or equal to the limit.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Enter description equal to max length
when the maximum limit
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Description Validation – Exact limit acceptance
Scenario: Enter description equal to max length
Given the maximum limit
When the user enters exactly the max characters
Then saving should still be permitted
test_cases.acceptance:
Saving should still be permitted
The behavior should be validated when the user enters exactly the max characters.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Enter description exceeding max length
when the Description field has a limit
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Description Validation – Block over-limit input
Scenario: Enter description exceeding max length
Given the Description field has a limit
When the user enters text exceeding the limit
Then saving should be blocked
test_cases.acceptance:
Saving should be blocked
The behavior should be validated when the user enters text exceeding the limit.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Over-limit validation message
when text exceeds the limit
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Description Validation – Error message display
Scenario: Over-limit validation message
Given text exceeds the limit
When the user attempts to save
Then a clear validation message should be shown
test_cases.acceptance:
A clear validation message should be shown
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to save.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Save without description
when the Description is empty
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Description Validation – Optional field behavior
Scenario: Save without description
Given the Description is empty
When the user clicks Save
Then the label should still be created successfully
test_cases.acceptance:
The label should still be created successfully
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Save.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Description saved in request
when valid text is entered
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Description Validation – Payload inclusion
Scenario: Description saved in request
Given valid text is entered
When the user saves
Then the Description should be included in the API payload
test_cases.acceptance:
The Description should be included in the API payload
The behavior should be validated when the user saves.
